decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the crossover is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - Front boundary treatment shall be reinstated except at point of access to path and hardstanding and shall be no greater than 600mm in height
Condition : 5 - The existing planting borders shall be retained along the north and south boundaries of the front garden.

Condition : 6 - The proposed vehicular crossover and off-street parking arrangements, by reason of their design, position and appearance, would be the sole means of vehicular access to the site, would not be detrimental to the character and appearance of the streetscene, and would not lead to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic or a decline in road safety. The proposal therefore accords with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, T.4.4 and T.5.3.
